"""Reproduce ticket #31877: TemplateView.get_context_data() kwargs crash when filtering."""
import warnings

import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth", "repro_app"],
    ROOT_URLCONF="repro_app.urls",
    USE_TZ=True,
    TEMPLATE_DIRS=["C:/Windows/Temp/repro_templates"],
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models  # noqa: E402


class Account(models.Model):
    slug = models.SlugField(unique=True)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro_app"


import os  # noqa: E402

os.makedirs("C:/Windows/Temp/repro_templates", exist_ok=True)
with open("C:/Windows/Temp/repro_templates/offer.html", "w") as f:
    f.write("offer: {{ offer.slug }} / slug: {{ offer_slug }}\n")

with open("C:/Windows/Temp/repro_app/__init__.py", "w") as f:
    f.write("")
with open("C:/Windows/Temp/repro_app/models.py", "w") as f:
    f.write("from django.db import models\n\n\nclass Account(models.Model):\n"
            "    slug = models.SlugField(unique=True)\n")
with open("C:/Windows/Temp/repro_app/urls.py", "w") as f:
    f.write("from django.urls import path\n"
            "from repro_app.views import OfferView\n\n"
            "urlpatterns = [path('offers/<slug:offer_slug>/', OfferView.as_view(), name='offer_view')]\n")

from django.views.generic import TemplateView  # noqa: E402
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404  # noqa: E402


class OfferView(TemplateView):
    template_name = "offer.html"

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        # Exactly the code from the ticket: NO str() conversion.
        offer_slug = kwargs.get("offer_slug", "")
        offer = get_object_or_404(Account, slug=offer_slug)
        return {"offer": offer, "offer_slug": offer_slug}


from django.test.utils import setup_test_environment  # noqa: E402

setup_test_environment()
from django.test.runner import DiscoverRunner  # noqa: E402

runner = DiscoverRunner(interactive=False, verbosity=0)
old_config = runner.setup_databases()
from django.core.management import call_command  # noqa: E402

call_command("migrate", run_syncdb=True, verbosity=0)
Account.objects.create(slug="coffee")

from django.test import Client  # noqa: E402

with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter("ignore")  # the RemovedInDjango40Warning is expected
    response = Client().get("/offers/coffee/")

print("status:", response.status_code)
print("body:", response.content.decode().strip())
assert response.status_code == 200, "view crashed"
assert "coffee" in response.content.decode(), "wrong offer rendered"
print("OK: filtering with the lazy URL kwarg worked without str() conversion")
runner.teardown_databases(old_config)
